mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (username, password, enabled) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{enabled})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, "password", enabled FROM askops_schema.sys_user

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.enabled, r.id AS role_id, r.role_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN user_role_mapping urm ON u.id = urm.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON urm.role_id = r.id ORDER BY u.id
